## Summary
- Adds opt-in, privacy-safe progress updates during Bonaparte reviews while preserving the bounded final stdout receipt.

## Changes
- Implements the review-only nonblocking progress reporter, descriptor lifecycle and descendant isolation, heartbeat and terminal events, plus operator guidance and regression coverage.

## Verification
- 36/36 unit tests passed on Python 3.10–3.14; Python compilation, installer shell syntax, CLI help, diff checks, descriptor diagnostics, receipt-boundary diagnostics, and GitHub validate all passed.

## Linear
- [COR-3451](https://linear.app/coreedgesolution/issue/COR-3451/stream-privacy-safe-progress-during-bonaparte-reviews)

<!-- CURSOR_SUMMARY -->
---

> [!NOTE]
> **Medium Risk**
> Changes review failure diagnostics (no stderr surfacing) and receipt validation behavior, plus a new FD/env contract; scope is limited to review and opt-in progress, with broad regression tests.
> 
> **Overview**
> Adds an **opt-in review-only liveness channel** for trusted hosts via `BONAPARTE_PROGRESS_FD` (nonblocking inherited FD ≥3). The runner emits **UTF-8 JSON Lines** (`started` → periodic `active` → `finalizing` → one terminal state matching the final receipt) with no sensitive data; write failures permanently disable progress with no fallback.
> 
> **`bonaparte`** wires a `ProgressReporter` through `main()`, dupes/closes the host FD so **Codex children never inherit it**, and keeps **stdout as a single bounded JSON receipt** (review uses a stricter 4 KiB budget including the trailing newline). Review now **validates coordinator receipts against the full schema**, drops coordinator **stderr** on non-zero exit (generic failure message only), and leaves other phases on the prior key-only validation and stderr behavior.
> 
> **`bonaparte-launcher`** strips `BONAPARTE_PROGRESS_FD` from update/git/validation subprocess environments so only the final `bonaparte` exec sees the channel. README and the use-bonaparte skill document the ABI; tests cover descriptor lifecycle, ordering, privacy, and installer isolation.
> 
> <sup>Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 1eb50570b1b635e8070bfd7cb5cfc45d048d208c. Bugbot is set up for automated code reviews on this repo. Configure [here](https://www.cursor.com/dashboard/bugbot).</sup>
